motivation: FlatListTextReplace::derive allocated owned text fragments for every untouched source block just to validate and discard them, and reparsed the already admitted edited span for its text-preservation decision. This repeats during action evaluation, inverse construction and transaction preflight.
change: Borrow untouched immutable text leaves for canonical-fragment admission, and compare already-admitted source/result fragments for the edited span. Owned fragment construction and borrowed validation share one allocation-free measurement helper. Complete source guards, schema/resource validation, inverse checks and registry preflight are unchanged. No new cache, wire tag, public API or shipping build.
correctness: Untouched prefix/suffix nodes in the derived result are exact immutable source clones. They still require block-kind, all-text-child, adjacent-format and aggregate-length admission, but do not require copied TextRuns. Source span fragments are admitted before replacement derivation, and rebuild uses exactly edit.result, so comparing those fragments preserves the original text-preservation predicate. The borrowed and owned paths share adjacent-format-first, then per-run UTF-16-before-byte-overflow error precedence. The check still runs only for equal total block counts, matching the original behavior; edited and inserted fragments retain their existing unconditional validation.
regressions: 511 exhaustive two-format patterns with 0-8 Unicode runs compare owned and borrowed admission against an independent adjacent-format oracle and exact lengths.

Synthetic metadata tests cover exact aggregate UTF-16/host-byte maxima, separate overflow failures, simultaneous overflow precedence and a later adjacent-format violation taking precedence over earlier length overflow without allocating enormous strings.
A list operation with untouched mixed-format Unicode prefix/suffix and an empty block retains exact nodes, text-preservation relocation and inverse document/summary.

Existing non-text untouched-block rejection, same-length changed-text rejection, complete-result limits, every-endpoint relocation, randomized sessions, history and codec laws remain in the full core suite.

retainedFailure.classification: Unresolved queue uncertainty during selection. No captured underlying executor/observer exception in this original uninstrumented artifact. No timing speedup claim or release qualification follows from this run.
